_about: Public-domain Henry Cowles (1803-1881), Oberlin professor and editor of the Oberlin Evangelist, for the Word Hoard: his commentary on most of the Bible, written 'for both pastors and people' (1866-1883): the Minor Prophets, Ezekiel and Daniel, Isaiah, Jeremiah and Lamentations, the Psalms, the Pentateuch, Hebrew History, Job, Proverbs-Ecclesiastes-Song, the Gospel and Epistles of John, Revelation, the Shorter and Longer Epistles of Paul, and Acts, from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 57 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

cowles-minor-prophets: The minor prophets : with notes, critical, explanatory, and practical, designed for both pastors and people (New York : Appleton, 1871)
cowles-ezekiel-daniel: Ezekiel and Daniel : with notes, critical, explanatory, and practical, designed for both pastors and people (New York : D. Appleton, 1871)
cowles-isaiah: Isaiah : with notes, critical, explanitory [sic] and practical (New York : D. Appleton, 1869)
cowles-jeremiah: Jeremiah, and his lamentations : with notes, critical, explanatory and practical, designed for both pastors and people (New York : D. Appleton, 1869)
cowles-pentateuch: The Pentateuch, in its progressive revelations of God to men : designed for both pastors and people (New York : D. Appleton, 1877)
cowles-hebrew-history: Hebrew history, from the death of Moses to the close of the Scripture narrative (New York, D. Appleton & co., 1875)
cowles-job: The book of Job : with notes, critical, explanatory and practical (New York : Appleton, 1877)
cowles-proverbs: Proverbs, Ecclesiastes, and the Song of Solomon : with notes, critical, explanatory and practical (New York : Appleton, 1878)

cowles-revelation: The Revelation of John with notes critical, explanatory and practical : designed for both pastors and people (New York : D. Appleton, 1877)

cowles-longer-epistles: The longer Epistles of Paul (New York, D. Appleton & company, 1880)
cowles-acts: Acts of the Apostles : with notes, critical, explanatory, and practical, designed for both pastors and people (N. Y. : D. Appleton, 1883)
